field_evidence.api_query_semantics: Planning Data documentation states that latitude and longitude can be supplied to /entity.json and the API returns entities whose geometry intersects/covers the point for the requested dataset.
field_evidence.target_coordinate: Forge Cottage listed-building-outline entity 42137146 provides POINT (0.910196 51.073494) and authoritative outline geometry.
field_evidence.title_boundary_semantics: Planning Data title-boundary entity pages expose MULTIPOLYGON geometry, point, quality=authoritative and HM Land Registry provenance.
field_evidence.transport_result: The custom title-boundary entity.json query could not be opened by the current web transport; no target-specific JSON/GeoJSON response was obtained.
field_evidence.parcel_limitation: Without the target-specific point-query response, no title-boundary entity can be bound or promoted to canonical parcel geometry/bbox in this producer.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. Planning Data's official API documentation supports latitude/longitude queries that return entities whose geometry intersects a point, and the verified Forge Cottage listed-building-outline entity supplies target point POINT (0.910196 51.073494). A materially different public/no-login title-boundary point-query window was attempted for that exact point, but this transport could not retrieve the custom entity.json response, so no target-specific title-boundary entity, canonical parcel geometry or bbox can be asserted. Local OpenCode or another browser/HTTP-capable workflow must retrieve and bind the target-specific title-boundary polygon; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official Planning Data API point-query route is materially different from the prior licensed HM Land Registry National Polygon Service route: it is public/no-login and is designed to return entities whose geometry covers a supplied coordinate. Forge Cottage has an authoritative Planning Data outline and point, but the custom title-boundary API request for that exact point is not accessible through this transport. Because no target-specific API response was retrieved, no title-boundary polygon is promoted to canonical parcel geometry and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
